scope: Capability Sprint A-G and L1/L2/L3; existing implementation distinguished from acceptance and new offline followups

classification.proven: Concrete evidence for the stated bounded behavior; no general task-quality inference
classification.missing_live_evidence: Implementation and programmatic coverage exist; successful live acceptance is absent or failed
classification.implementation_gap: A specific absent or insufficient behavior in source, independently of live evidence
classification.continuation_offline_fix: New source or regression work after the closed final evidence, requiring separate acceptance

requirements.requirement: Accurate multi-Workspace intent and Quest association
requirements.implemented: Explicit project identity, scoped source selection and authoritative continuation links; scheduler discovery correction exists
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed continuity run linked both tasks to beta; the later correction has offline evidence only
requirements.minimal_next: Rerun the unchanged two-project scenario and inspect actual Quest metadata and source scopes

requirements.requirement: Continuously coordinate several parallel tasks
requirements.implemented: Task lookup, coordination projection, hidden independent runs and original Router ownership
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed live ownership intervals overlapped for three Workers and two tasks; both tasks did not complete
requirements.minimal_next: Observe independently accepted terminal results from both tasks at the same Router

requirements.requirement: Batch events and avoid unnecessary model calls
requirements.implemented: Fast Path, internal progress acknowledgment, progress batching and Thread pass-through
requirements.evidence_boundary: Both closed continuity followups passed through without an additional router_trigger inference
requirements.minimal_next: Retain the existing no-extra-call assertions in the new acceptance

requirements.requirement: Task priority, blocking judgment and proactive progress reports
requirements.implemented: Priorities, blocked coordination facts, result/progress events and bounded Router notices
requirements.evidence_boundary: Notice retries exhausted the old hard call ceiling; final reviewed completion was not delivered
requirements.minimal_next: Budget actual progress and completion notices inside original task call limits; verify processed notice source IDs

requirements.requirement: Judge Worker results, ask followups, redelegate and terminate
requirements.implemented: Independent review, bounded revision, source-bound help/reassignment and transactional lifecycle controls
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real Reviewer judgments occurred; controlled live expert replacement/followup/termination has not been accepted
requirements.minimal_next: Reuse the existing contracts and execute one bounded source-bound reassignment with explicit evidence classes

requirements.requirement: Router remains a reasoning coordinator rather than a registration/forwarding service
requirements.implemented: Model decisions, workspace-scoped memory/Recall and task/team selection are in the real Core lifecycle
requirements.evidence_boundary: Source proves the mechanism; autonomous multi-task completion and useful recovery remain unaccepted
requirements.minimal_next: Score actual original-user outcomes, not admission counts or Worker existence

requirements.requirement: An independent model reasoning and tool-call loop
requirements.implemented: Private Worker messages, own model calls, tool checkpoints and governed actual execution
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed L1/L3 made real source reads; L3 wrote and executed real Python

requirements.requirement: Plan internal subtasks and dependencies for complex work
requirements.implemented: Versioned team assignments and verified graph dependency fences
requirements.evidence_boundary: Hierarchical L2 started Research and Architect, but its dependent integrator never ran
requirements.minimal_next: Complete one full specialist-to-integrator dependency chain on fixed material

requirements.requirement: Bounded expert collaboration and dynamic expansion
requirements.implemented: Actual model tool transcript required for expansion/help; at most four cumulative Workers and depth one
requirements.evidence_boundary: SQLite/Gateway scripted fixtures cover expansion, fan-in and revocation; no accepted real-model expansion
requirements.minimal_next: Use an existing bounded expert request on the same parent mandate without adding budgets

requirements.requirement: Classify errors, adjust strategy, retry finitely and request help
requirements.implemented: Known error categories, bounded repair, exact R2 reauthorization and source-bound help
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real starter test failure/correction occurred; L3's original receipt-report acceptance still failed
requirements.minimal_next: Bind corrected code, successful tests and reported actual receipt IDs on a new task run

requirements.requirement: Pause, resume, cancel and crash recovery
requirements.implemented: Generation/lease fences and durable control state; unknown effects fail closed
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed continuity restarted the same Router and Workers while awaiting R2 authorization; programmatic controls cover lifecycle behavior

requirements.requirement: Do not solve defects by increasing tokens, output or retries
requirements.implemented: Existing call/token/time/step/tool limits, fixed repair bounds and reserved/unknown accounting
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed failure attempts consumed the same 160-call ceiling; later context declaration correction was documented separately from cumulative task spending
requirements.minimal_next: Freeze the new protocol before calls; preserve unchanged per-task limits and every failure

requirements.requirement: Single Worker baseline
requirements.implemented: Single topology and original independent loop
requirements.evidence_boundary: A closed single run failed on an earlier source version, so it is not a controlled current-source baseline
requirements.minimal_next: Execute the frozen L2 task once under single policy with the same budget

requirements.requirement: Parallel specialists
requirements.implemented: Independent assignments with bounded concurrency
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real Research/Architect ownership overlapped; only Research passed
requirements.minimal_next: Require accepted results from all specialists and their final integration

requirements.requirement: Sequential specialists
requirements.implemented: Declared successful-ancestor dependencies and source-verified delivery reading
requirements.evidence_boundary: The fixed sequential experiment blocked at its first Worker
requirements.minimal_next: Run the same frozen L2 once as Research to Architect to Reviewer

requirements.requirement: Hierarchical team
requirements.implemented: Parent assignments, bounded depth and verified fan-in
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real hierarchy was admitted; its final integrator did not start
requirements.minimal_next: Complete the original source-bound fan-in without synthetic PASS or result insertion

requirements.requirement: Dynamic expansion
requirements.implemented: Original transcript/mandate-bound expert expansion and cumulative resource accounting
requirements.evidence_boundary: Covered by offline model protocol tests only
requirements.minimal_next: A real-model help/expansion request is required for live dynamic-expansion acceptance

requirements.requirement: Model replacement
requirements.implemented: Existing non-help reassign_expert branch excludes the failed provider/model pair and retains original allocations. New narrow proof distinguishes a fully received, uniquely bound Gateway rejected operation from unknown execution while preserving its unknown usage and every local/Gateway token/cost reservation
requirements.evidence_boundary: Dedicated programmatic tests cover actual Worker error generation, Gateway/native framing/complete HTTP 503, backup-model continuation, unknown/partial-body/source-tamper refusal and residual budget fences. No real Provider recovery call has been made by this audit
requirements.minimal_next: A separately labeled injected failure plus actual backup-model continuation can establish bounded mixed recovery evidence

requirements.requirement: Choose team/model by complexity, capability, reliability, tools, cost and latency, and compare single/fixed/dynamic policies
requirements.implemented: Role constraints, capability thresholds, source/confidence-aware utility, observed rates and latency penalties
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed comparisons span source fixes and incomplete outcomes. They cannot show policy superiority
requirements.minimal_next: Use identical frozen tasks/material/oracle and equal caps; disclose n=1 per policy as exploratory

requirements.requirement: Discover available models and capability information
requirements.implemented: Allowlisted Provider identity/context/output/tool/structured declarations with provenance; existing operator profiles are not overwritten
requirements.evidence_boundary: Discovery is declared metadata, not measured intelligence or a verified upstream identity

requirements.requirement: Measure actual latency, throughput and failure rate
requirements.implemented: Gateway observation records, transport rates, token throughput and latency summaries
requirements.evidence_boundary: Actual closed calls and both model microprobe traces exist. A transport success is never a task success

requirements.requirement: Track task success, tool success and Reviewer pass rate
requirements.implemented: Existing Core result/tool/review events feed measured rates; infrastructure review errors are distinguished from judgments
requirements.evidence_boundary: Metrics describe their observed denominators and provenance, not arbitrary-task reliability

requirements.requirement: Benchmark mathematics, programming, research, design, vision and planning
requirements.implemented: Six small text/code dimensions run with fixed oracles and zero HTTP retries; vision is explicitly unsupported
requirements.evidence_boundary: Twelve actual calls across deepseek-v4.1-flash and glm-5.3-flash are capability microprobes; one case per dimension cannot establish model strength. Vision execution remains unavailable
requirements.minimal_next: Retain unknown vision and small-sample limitations; do not invent measured scores or silently enable unsupported multimodal input

requirements.requirement: Record source, sample size, measurement time and confidence
requirements.implemented: Sourced immutable profile/measurement metadata and Wilson confidence for observed rates
requirements.evidence_boundary: New selection confidence uses online rates only at n>=5; that floor is not statistical sufficiency

requirements.requirement: Task-level dynamic model routing and fault fallback
requirements.implemented: TeamCompositionService supplies actual performance_snapshot; candidate scores use capability/tools/cost, sourced online outcome Wilson lower bounds and p95 latency. Settled failure replacement excludes original identity
requirements.evidence_boundary: Synthetic fixtures change routing/reassignment and new offline failover tests pass. No controlled real task routing comparison exists
requirements.minimal_next: Run identical bounded source tasks through two eligible actual models, then compare observed task outcome/calls/tokens/latency without claiming superiority

requirements.requirement: Use authorized local Providers, never print keys/change Provider files/increase budget
requirements.implemented: Native ProviderGateway and original credential resolver; Core policies and original accounting remain
requirements.evidence_boundary: This audit and its new tests make zero real Provider calls and do not access credentials

requirements.requirement: Cross-project automatic identification
requirements.implemented: Generic project discovery, project IDs and source-bound followup identity
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed two-project run was misassociated; discovery correction is only programmatically proven
requirements.minimal_next: Verify two independently identified project roots in new actual Quest/source metadata

requirements.requirement: Memory isolation among Workspaces
requirements.implemented: Project-focused lexical/semantic/object/archive memory and explicit cross-project opt-in
requirements.evidence_boundary: Programmatic scoped retrieval/revocation tests are strong; closed live project-link failure prevents claiming full continuity acceptance

requirements.requirement: Retrieve across Quests, Workers, Artifacts and decisions
requirements.implemented: Typed object references and original source/evidence readback
requirements.evidence_boundary: Recall graph covers the existing objects without a new parallel memory store

requirements.requirement: Multi-hop Recall
requirements.implemented: Bounded typed traversal and relation/source pagination already exist
requirements.evidence_boundary: Closed real traversal stopped incomplete at the fixed 64-node bound
requirements.minimal_next: Use existing targeted/paginated followup retrieval; do not raise the graph bound to hide the missing traversal

requirements.requirement: Restore context in a long-lived conversation
requirements.implemented: Persistent Router capsule, Worker archives/handoffs and source recovery
requirements.evidence_boundary: Five Router messages were compacted and Core restarted; accepted final recap after compaction was absent
requirements.minimal_next: Deliver a source-correct recap in the original conversation after restart and compaction

requirements.requirement: Keep original evidence traceable after compaction
requirements.implemented: Immutable originals, exact hash chains, source indices and governed readback
requirements.evidence_boundary: Programmatic corruption/revocation/readback tests cover the mechanism; source possession does not itself prove semantic recall quality

requirements.requirement: One conversation entrance for the user
requirements.implemented: Persistent main Router and hidden independent Workers report internally
requirements.evidence_boundary: Original Router identity survives the closed restart. Reviewed final completion delivery remains a separate unmet G gate

requirements.requirement: Detect hung Workers separately from process heartbeat
requirements.implemented: Durable checkpoint fingerprint and bounded deduplicated help; heartbeat and lease renewal cannot reset its window
requirements.evidence_boundary: Existing tests cover live lease/no progress, concurrent Watchdogs and restart deduplication

requirements.requirement: Detect long periods of no actual task progress, even while inference/read activity continues
requirements.implemented: New independent productive frontier uses distinct fixed tool-result content hashes, consumed inbox cursor and task-node state. Repeated thoughts, settled model calls and identical read receipts cannot reset it
requirements.evidence_boundary: Six new programmatic tests plus the existing recovery suite pass. It is a conservative diagnostic, not a semantic quality oracle or an automatic replay/termination policy
requirements.minimal_next: Inspect productive-frontier events during a bounded new real run and keep false-positive/recovery-quality conclusions exploratory

requirements.requirement: Detect Provider failures
requirements.implemented: Provenance-separated transport health, consecutive errors, cooldown and unknown/in-flight distinctions, including stopped Workers
requirements.evidence_boundary: Transport health detection exists. Successful live backup-model recovery is still missing

requirements.requirement: Detect abnormal execution environments
requirements.implemented: Revalidate per-run execution paths/environment before expired-lease recovery
requirements.evidence_boundary: Programmatic invalid-environment tests reject recovery; cwd isolation is not an OS security sandbox

requirements.requirement: Recover expired leases
requirements.implemented: CAS release/requeue with generation and owner fences; reconcile known Gateway usage first
requirements.evidence_boundary: Concurrent Watchdogs and stale-owner refusal are programmatically tested

requirements.requirement: Recover component crashes
requirements.implemented: Bounded supervise/restart with backoff and stable-operation restart credit
requirements.evidence_boundary: Programmatic loop factory/backoff tests plus actual host restart in closed continuity; this does not establish long-duration autonomous reliability

requirements.requirement: Protect unknown external side effects and never replay unknown operations
requirements.implemented: Unresolved tool/model/action intent fences; diagnostic recovery remains observe_only_unknown_effect
requirements.evidence_boundary: Unknown actions and calls block reassignment/recovery; new productive diagnostics leave lease, reservations and Worker state untouched

requirements.requirement: Filesystem
requirements.implemented: Scoped actual reads/writes/revisions/list/create with original policy, approvals and receipts
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real L1 source reads and L3 writes occurred

requirements.requirement: Python
requirements.implemented: Fixed compile/evaluation/test tools and exact-manifest R2 CPython unittest with a private cwd and process-tree deadline
requirements.evidence_boundary: Real L3 ran visible tests; seven independent host holdouts passed. Neither constitutes a general OS sandbox

requirements.requirement: Git
requirements.implemented: Governed git_status only
requirements.evidence_boundary: Patch/commit/general Git mutation is not part of this tool contract
requirements.minimal_next: Document this gradual-expansion boundary; implement additional exact contracts only when required by a concrete task

requirements.requirement: Terminal
requirements.implemented: Fixed shell_inspect python_version probe only
requirements.evidence_boundary: No general terminal execution or package installation
requirements.minimal_next: Avoid claiming general terminal coverage; preserve minimal permissions

requirements.requirement: Browser
requirements.implemented: Approved allowlisted HTTPS browser_get
requirements.evidence_boundary: No interactive browser. Browser is not silently granted by the autonomous local SAFE_TOOLS mandate
requirements.minimal_next: Use explicit governed approval if a task needs an allowed read; do not add blanket network authority

requirements.requirement: MCP
requirements.implemented: Operator-preconfigured allowlisted server/tool calls with R2 approval
requirements.evidence_boundary: Autonomous local mandates do not grant MCP by default; no task-level live MCP acceptance in this Sprint
requirements.minimal_next: Keep exact configured tool approval; do not reinterpret general user intent as new MCP permission

requirements.requirement: GPU diagnostics
requirements.implemented: Bounded read-only GPU probe and explicit unsupported/unavailable results
requirements.evidence_boundary: Hardware availability is an observation, not a measured ability to run arbitrary GPU jobs

requirements.requirement: Recognize a local project, read actual files and produce independently correct repair recommendations
requirements.implemented: Actual Worker and Reviewer plus strict source/hash/line/quote checker
requirements.evidence_boundary: One retained L1 task passed; the later combined task failed. Current-source reacceptance still required

requirements.requirement: Research an Agent framework, compare technical designs and deliver a reviewed specialist report
requirements.evidence_boundary: Fixed run blocked at Research; later hierarchy passed Research but blocked Architect, so no final integrator or complete report
requirements.minimal_next: Complete one frozen-source L2 report with strict source citations and final Reviewer/integrator

requirements.requirement: Autonomously plan a small feature, write code, run/fix tests and deliver real code with exact evidence
requirements.evidence_boundary: Actual code/Core completion/Reviewer PASS and seven host holdouts passed; original report referenced inferred action names rather than actual receipt IDs, so original acceptance failed. Two later extraction probes are not a task rerun
requirements.minimal_next: Full unchanged-task rerun on fixed source with current-hash test receipts and independent holdouts

requirements.requirement: One scenario with two Workspaces, parallel Workers, pass-through, Core restart, compaction, Chain of Recall and final result at original Router
requirements.evidence_boundary: Pass-through, three overlapping Worker ownership intervals, same-state restart and five compacted Router messages were observed; ownership is not CPU parallelism. Project links were wrong, Recall incomplete at its bound, and no reviewed final completion was delivered
requirements.minimal_next: A new scenario must pass every conjunct; use existing paginated Recall and reserve calls for actual final notices/recap

requirements.requirement: Mark real Provider, Mock and programmatic evidence separately
requirements.implemented: Closed final evidence has explicit classes; new regression files label Mock/programmatic fixtures
requirements.evidence_boundary: A local HTTP/Gateway fixture with execution_mode=live is still scripted protocol evidence. An injected failure plus real backup is mixed evidence, not a naturally occurring Provider failure

adaptive_team_composition.boundary: 90 actual policy-ablation rows and 135 calls used only deepseek-v4.1-flash; source reader was fixture-controlled, not autonomous Quest execution. Reusable methodology, not current task acceptance or diverse-model routing evidence
adaptive_team_composition.required_new: Same frozen L2 task/material/oracle under single, fixed and dynamic team policies; equal original limits; preserve every failure and report exploratory n

task_centric_context.existing: v16 fixed distractor/context ablations and current source-bound archive/Recall tests
task_centric_context.required_new: Post-compaction original-task recap with exact source provenance and paginated Recall within existing bounds

self_recovery.existing: Expired lease/unknown effect/component crash tests plus closed actual Core restart
self_recovery.required_new: Finite known-failure injection with preserved original allocation and actual backup-model work; measure restoration and evidence integrity rather than heartbeat alone

model_routing_comparison.microprobes_only: Twelve actual calls compare six tiny dimensions across proxy-declared deepseek-v4.1-flash and glm-5.3-flash; these are not task-level model routing results

suggested_bounded_new_protocol.precondition: Both remain discoverable, enabled and compatible under the existing Provider and current tool/context metadata; fail closed if either is absent
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.task: Same tiny source-referenced bug diagnosis and exact independently scored output under a one-Worker fixed contract
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.routing_rows: Two actual models, one identical task each, maximum four model attempts per row including review; record selected identity/score/provenance and all actual Gateway use
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.recovery_row: At most eight further attempts total: a one-shot explicitly injected complete HTTP 503 at a trusted probe proxy for the primary Worker, then the source-bound Worker blocked/reassign_expert branch and actual compatible backup-model continuation
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.injection_boundary: The one-shot proxy rejection is programmatic, not an upstream natural failure. Native Gateway records rejected and the strict source-bound proof distinguishes known operation outcome from unknown usage. Keep local reserved and Gateway rejected token/cost reserves unchanged with actual usage NULL; do not invent a model response, usage or settlement
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.limits: All calls also debit the new phase's fixed total; keep original per-task token/time/output/tool/retry limits; no extra calls when the reserved sixteen are exhausted
suggested_bounded_new_protocol.limitations: n=1 per actual model, no causal superiority or general success-rate claim; local proxy 503 is mixed programmatic fault injection plus actual-model recovery evidence

research.claims: Exploratory only; no policy or model is declared optimal

minimum_unfinished_work: Finish the genuine L2 context-affordability defect using original capacity and spending fences, without increasing limits
Freeze current source and acceptance protocol before new actual model calls
Reaccept correct project association and final reviewed completion to original Router, including post-compaction source-correct recall
Run the same fixed L2 under single/fixed/dynamic policies once; do not retrofit old source-version failures into a controlled comparison
Use the reserved bounded real-model routing/recovery experiment only with explicit injected-failure provenance
Keep vision/general Terminal/general Git/interactive Browser and long-duration recovery quality as explicit remaining capability boundaries
